turnCoverage.note: §6.3.7: never a reward, never part of the verdict.

issues: Treats the two abstract-level model publications (S2, S3) as full-text evidence, contradicting the brief's mustDo to record them as abstract-level until full text is preserved and mustNotDo not to call the two model abstracts full text.
Introduces unverified PMC full-text details (sample sizes, AUCs, HRs, hashes) beyond the abstract-level sources supplied, so those numeric claims are not bonded to preserved evidence.
The input sources list accessLevel 'abstract' for S2/S3, so the delivered full-text evidence level cannot be verified from the brief's materials.
judge.rationale: The delivery is thorough, answers both layers, preserves roles, and leaves cohort overlap unresolved with a useful field list. However, it upgrades S2/S3 from abstract-level to full-text, violating mustDo and mustNotDo, and bases numeric details on claimed PMC full texts not among the supplied sources. This weakens correctness and evidence handling. Safety framing remains cautious, with no clinical advice and appropriately uncertain risk statements.

qualityNotices: literature_search searched and returned no source

review weakened: S2-FINEGRAY — 数值属实（MIMIC-IV subdistribution HR 0.878，95% CI 0.758–1.017，P=0.082；eICU 0.915，0.835–1.002，P=0.057），且该分析确由论文自行披露；但交付把它述为「把关联削弱到不显著」，而论文自身在统计段落写的结论是竞争风险分析「further confirmed the protective association」。数值一致、方向性解释与来源相反，故此条作为评价判断而非事实仍可站住，措辞应下调。
review weakened: S2-INDEPENDENT-DB — PMC12832424 讨论段确称「external validation in an independent database」，而交付的逐篇与 B3 只写 MIMIC-IV 是其跨库验证支，未记录作者这一独立性与否的立场。交付的未解决结论不受影响（作者所指为数据库层面独立），但该处来源陈述在产物中缺失。
review weakened: S2-DOI-DEFECT — S2 参考文献 15 确以 10.1038/s41597-023-01945-2 标注 MIMIC-IV 数据描述文献；但独立检索显示该 DOI 对应的是同篇论文的作者更正（PMID 36646711），并非「可能导致落到无关记录」以外的问题——交付把它记为可解析性缺陷方向正确，理由表述略强。
review weakened: S3-BOOTSTRAP — 499 bootstrap 校正确存在（C-index 0.795→0.767），但「该校正未覆盖 LASSO 选型这一步」是交付的推断：正文只写用 500 次重抽样计算乐观校正 C-index，未说明重抽样内是否重跑 LASSO。作为偏倚担忧可保留，作为对论文报告内容的断言则超出证据。

review weakened: S3-IMPRECISION-GRADE — n=149、33 事件与区间 0.772–0.919 属实，论文自陈事件数少可能限制稳定性；但 95% CI 下限 0.772 从不进入「仅与 SOFA 相当」的区间，交付称其跨越「优于 SOFA」与「仅相当」两种结论，是其自身的解释而非来源事实。且评为 critical 却只降 1 步，与该体系对 critical 的通常含义不一致（交付已声明非认证 GRADE）。

review weakened: X-DB-UNRESOLVED — 「未解决」在证据上成立：两篇均未报告提取期、标识符或重叠声明，我独立核查亦如此。但交付把重叠可能性写成对称的「无法判定任一方向」，而它自己列出的机制（两篇同为 v2.2、时间跨度同指 2008–2019、同为 Sepsis-3、同为仅首次 ICU 入住，且 S2 版块定义不排除腹腔感染来源）只支持单侧推断（可能重叠，不可能被证明互斥）。方向性应对称性表述修正，条件句「可直接提取标识符判定」若与数据使用协议冲突还需另设前置条件。
